name: pico-lsp
description: PICO-8 language support for VS Code: diagnostics, completion, navigation, formatting, and cart budgets, powered by pico-lsp.

pico8.apiVersion.markdownDescription: PICO-8 API version. Only `0.2.7` is currently supported; unsupported values fall back to `0.2.7` with a one-time warning. See the [configuration reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#settings).

pico8.typeChecking.markdownDescription: Type-diagnostic mode. `off` keeps annotations for hover and completion but publishes no type diagnostics; `basic` checks explicit annotations and class inheritance; `strict` also checks nil access and missing fields for open records. See the [configuration reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#settings).

pico8.maxProblems.description: Maximum diagnostics per document. Set to 0 to disable truncation.

pico8.limits.markdownDescription: Controls the cart-budget code lens and token, character, and compressed-size limit diagnostics. See the [configuration reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#settings).

codeLens.description: Show the cart budget code lens.

diagnostics.description: Publish token, character, and compressed-size limit diagnostics.

maxBlankLines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines kept when formatting. Set to 0 to remove blank lines.

pico8.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Diagnostic transport and severity settings. Each severity rule accepts `off`, `hint`, `info`, `warning`, or `error`. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

mode.description: Diagnostic transport. auto pulls when the client supports pull diagnostics and publishes otherwise; push always publishes; pull suppresses duplicate push publication.

undefinedGlobal.markdownDescription: Severity for undefined global reads. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

unusedLocal.markdownDescription: Severity for unused local variables. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

unreachableCode.markdownDescription: Severity for unreachable code. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

duplicateTableField.markdownDescription: Severity for duplicate table fields. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

callbackPrecedence.markdownDescription: Severity for PICO-8 callback precedence hints. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

callbackParams.markdownDescription: Severity for PICO-8 callback parameter checks. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

noStdlib.markdownDescription: Severity for PICO-8 no-standard-library hints. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

shadowedLocal.markdownDescription: Severity for shadowed local variables. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

emptyBlock.markdownDescription: Severity for empty blocks. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

globalInFunction.markdownDescription: Severity for globals assigned inside functions. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

includeOutsideWorkspace.markdownDescription: Severity for includes outside the workspace. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

includeUnusualType.markdownDescription: Severity for includes with unusual file types. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

includeDuplicate.markdownDescription: Severity for duplicate includes. See the [diagnostic reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md).

pico8.lint.markdownDescription: Optional PICO-8 lint checks. See the [configuration reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#settings).

pico8.refactors.markdownDescription: Refactor and code-action settings. See the [configuration reference](https://github.com/asimmons91/pico-lsp/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#settings).

enabled.description: Offer extract-function, rewrite, generated class, missing-field, and unused-removal code actions.

pico8.glyphs.markdownDescription: Custom P8SCII glyph snippets for `p8_` completion and the **PICO-8: Insert P8SCII Glyph** picker. Each item has a `name` and exactly one of `byte`, `glyph`, or `text`.

byte.description: Printable P8SCII byte. Use text for control codes.

glyph.description: A P8SCII character that encodes to exactly one byte.

text.description: A P8SCII control escape such as \14. Requires context string.

context.description: Where the glyph may be inserted. Text entries require string.

aliases.description: Additional p8_ or p8- completion triggers.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in completion and the picker.

pico8.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `pico-lsp` executable. When set, the extension does not download a server.

pico8.autoDownload.description: Download the matching checksummed pico-lsp release when no cached server is available.

pico8.attachLua.description: Attach pico-lsp to all .lua files in workspace folders that contain a .p8 cart.

pico8.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and pico-lsp.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:test && tsx test/integration/run.ts
